visualReview.scope: Detailed exterior, open seating bowl and portable materials.
visualReview.notes: All eleven final portable and eleven shared frames inspected, plus full-resolution roof, seats and exterior. Structural bowl underside now closes the previously see-through shell; photovoltaic rows are visibly above the corrected membrane. Field/goals, chair mosaic, aisles, western boxes, concrete crown/ribs, monumental ramps and cable ring are connected.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Shared concrete, membrane and painted metal use metric scale; chair/turf colors remain inexpensive local PBR. Clear visual separation of roof/PV and structure retained. Thin cable raster aliasing occurs at far distances without missing geometry. Geographic and unload assertions pass.

geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped pitch establishes center and short/long axes; native west side contains press boxes. North-up overlay confirms main oval and two long access ramps within mapped envelope. Overall model bounds include ramps and are not scaled to the295×258m roof measurement. Minor concrete foot bevel extends0.103m below the reviewed gradeY0.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Roof engineer dimensions/current exterior and structural photos, Rio owner installation manual and exact mapped axes constrain recognizable architecture. Seat distribution is reconstructed from the published mosaic, not a certified ticket inventory; cable prestress and individual workshop sections are outside visible exterior accuracy. Detached Maracanazinho and other neighboring sports facilities remain separate assets.
